item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to force the ace of spades: tapped pairs are kept if they include it and discarded otherwise; the final tapped card is kept only if it is the ace of spades, otherwise discarded."}
